message.content: The full suite confirms a single existing failure, and the reproduction shows that normal integer fields are also being sent to `_parse_data`. I’ll correct the two branches, keep data parsing in the documented parenthesized format, and add regression tests for SysEx, integer-valued fields, and time.

function.name: bash
function.arguments:
{"command":"cd /testbed && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('mido/messages/strings.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace("        elif name == 'data':\n            value = int(value)\n        else:\n            value = _parse_data(value)\n", "        elif name == 'data':\n            value = _parse_data(value)\n        else:\n            value = int(value)\n")
p.write_text(s)

p = Path('tests/messages/test_strings.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace("def test_decode_sysex():\n    assert Message.from_str('sysex data=(1,2,3)').data == (1, 2, 3)\n", "def test_decode_sysex():\n    assert Message.from_str('sysex data=(1,2,3)').data == (1, 2, 3)\n\n\ndef test_decode_integer_values_and_time():\n    msg = Message.from_str(\n        'control_change channel=2 control=1 value=122 time=0.5')\n    assert msg.channel == 2\n    assert msg.control == 1\n    assert msg.value == 122\n    assert msg.time == 0.5\n\n\ndef test_decode_empty_sysex():\n    assert Message.from_str('sysex data=()').data == ()\n")
p.write_text(s)
PY
cat > /tmp/reproduce_mido_string_parsing.py <<'PY'
import mido

cases = [
    ('sysex data=(10,20,30)', mido.Message('sysex', data=(10, 20, 30))),
    ('sysex data=()', mido.Message('sysex', data=())),
    (
        'control_change channel=2 control=1 value=122 time=0.5',
        mido.Message('control_change', channel=2, control=1, value=122, time=0.5),
    ),
    ('pitchwheel pitch=-200', mido.Message('pitchwheel', pitch=-200)),
]
for text, expected in cases:
    message = mido.parse_string(text)
    assert message == expected, (message, expected)
    print(f'PASS {text!r}: {message}')
PY
PYTHONPATH=/testbed python /tmp/reproduce_mido_string_parsing.py && python -m pytest && git diff --check && git diff -- mido/messages/strings.py tests/messages/test_strings.py"}
